has_sidewalk.description: Sidewalk along a carriageway from OSM sidewalk=*; separate = mapped as its own way; not_applicable = the segment is itself a pedestrian way. NULL = not tagged.
has_sidewalk.unit: none (identifier, code, flag, count or text)
has_sidewalk.null_semantics: NULL = no sidewalk tag (has_sidewalk_source = missing); 'not_applicable' is a value for pedestrian ways, not NULL

has_sidewalk_source.unit: none (identifier, code, flag, count or text)

slope_dem_abs_mean_pct.description: Length-weighted mean absolute grade over <=10 m pieces.
slope_dem_abs_mean_pct.null_semantics: NULL exactly where slope_dem_pct is NULL

slope_dem_note.description: Why no slope was derived: deck/tunnel not on the terrain model, segment < 5 m, or outside the DEM (buffer area).
slope_dem_note.unit: none (identifier, code, flag, count or text)
slope_dem_note.null_semantics: NULL when a slope was derived (slope_dem_source = dem); otherwise bridge_tunnel | too_short | outside_dem

comfort_score.description: Modelled, not measured. Pedestrian comfort 0-100: weighted mean of the components that have a value (weights surface 0.2, slope 0.2, lighting 0.15, shade 0.1, street 0.25, crossing 0.1; design choice, config/scoring/comfort.yml); steps capped at 35. NULL = comfort_null_reason.
comfort_score.null_semantics: NULL = not scored (comfort_null_reason = insufficient_components); NOT zero comfort

comfort_confidence.description: Modelled, not measured. 0-1: weight-share of the applicable components that have a value, with inferred values counted at half (observed 1, inferred 0.5, missing 0).

comfort_class.description: comfort_score class: very_low < 20 <= low < 40 <= moderate < 60 <= good < 80 <= very_good. NULL when not scored.
comfort_class.unit: none (identifier, code, flag, count or text)
comfort_class.null_semantics: NULL exactly where comfort_score is NULL

comfort_null_reason.description: Why comfort_score is NULL: insufficient_components = the components with a value carry less than 40 % of the applicable weight. NULL when scored.
comfort_null_reason.unit: none (identifier, code, flag, count or text)
comfort_null_reason.null_semantics: NULL when comfort_score exists; insufficient_components when the available components carry < 40 % of the applicable weight

comfort_surface.description: Modelled, not measured. Surface comfort from OSM surface=* (asphalt/concrete best, soft or rough worst; table in config/scoring/comfort.yml). NULL = surface unknown or value not in the table. Weight 0.2.
comfort_surface.null_semantics: NULL = surface unknown or value not in the scoring table; component dropped (comfort_surface_basis = missing)

comfort_slope.description: Modelled, not measured. Slope comfort from the DEM grade (slope_dem_abs_mean_pct), piecewise linear: 0 % = 100, 6 % = 60 (DIN 18040 ramp limit), 15 % = 0. NULL = no DEM slope (bridge/tunnel, < 5 m, outside DEM) or steps (not applicable). Weight 0.2.
comfort_slope.null_semantics: NULL = no DEM slope or steps (not applicable); component dropped

comfort_lighting.description: Modelled, not measured. Lighting comfort from OSM lit=* (lit 100, limited/partial 60, unlit 20). NULL = lit unknown (also when the tag is not understood). Weight 0.15.
comfort_lighting.null_semantics: NULL = lit unknown or tag not understood; component dropped

comfort_shade.description: Modelled, not measured. Shade proxy from street-tree density within 30 m per hectare of the segment corridor (saturates at 40 trees/ha), raised to an ALKIS land-use floor in forest/copse/cemetery. A proxy for canopy, not measured shade; tunnels not applicable; NULL outside the tree cadastre (Hamburg only). Weight 0.1.
comfort_shade.null_semantics: NULL outside the tree cadastre (Hamburg only) or tunnels (not applicable); component dropped

comfort_shade_basis.description: Provenance of comfort_shade: observed = derived from a source dataset; inferred = class/geometry rule or absence of evidence (modelled); missing = no value, component dropped and confidence lowered; not_applicable = does not exist for this segment type, left out of score and confidence.
comfort_shade_basis.unit: none (identifier, code, flag, count or text)

comfort_street.description: Modelled, not measured. Street environment: pedestrian ways by class (pedestrian > footway > path > track), minus a penalty when next to a busy road; carriageways by speed and sidewalk presence (tagged, or inferred from a parallel mapped footway). Crossings not applicable. Weight 0.25.
comfort_street.null_semantics: NULL for crossings (not applicable) or when no street-environment input exists; component dropped

comfort_crossing.description: Modelled, not measured. Crossing comfort by OSM crossing=* type (signals/zebra best, unmarked/informal worst). Only for crossing segments; all other segments not applicable. Weight 0.1.
comfort_crossing.null_semantics: NULL for every segment that is not a crossing (not applicable)

n_accidents_ped_5y.description: Destatis Unfallatlas accidents in the five selected non-pandemic years (2019, 2022-2025) with IstFuss=1, assigned once to this segment within 30 m. Count, not an exposure-adjusted risk.
n_accidents_ped_5y.unit: none (identifier, code, flag, count or text)

n_accidents_bike_5y.description: Destatis Unfallatlas accidents in the five selected non-pandemic years (2019, 2022-2025) with IstRad=1, assigned once to this segment within 30 m. Count, not an exposure-adjusted risk.
n_accidents_bike_5y.unit: none (identifier, code, flag, count or text)

n_accidents_vru_5y.description: Unique Unfallatlas accidents in the five selected non-pandemic years (2019, 2022-2025) involving a person walking or cycling, assigned once to the nearest segment within 30 m. A crash involving both modes is counted once. Count, not an exposure-adjusted risk.

accident_rate_smoothed.description: Modelled, not measured. Gamma-Poisson empirical-Bayes vulnerable-road-user accident rate per km over the selected five non-pandemic years: (count + Hamburg-wide rate * 0.25 km) / (length + 0.25 km). NULL outside Hamburg accident coverage.
accident_rate_smoothed.null_semantics: NULL outside Hamburg accident coverage (safety_null_reason = outside_accident_coverage); NOT zero accidents

safety_index.description: Modelled crash-concentration index, 0-100 (higher = lower modelled concentration): 100 * 2^(-accident_rate_smoothed / 8). This is not exposure-adjusted risk. NULL outside Hamburg accident coverage.
safety_index.null_semantics: NULL = no safety score (outside Hamburg accident coverage); NOT zero safety and NOT a safe segment

safety_null_reason.description: Why safety fields are NULL: outside_accident_coverage = segment lies in the routing buffer outside Hamburg. NULL when calculated.
safety_null_reason.unit: none (identifier, code, flag, count or text)
safety_null_reason.null_semantics: NULL when the safety index was calculated (inside Hamburg accident coverage); outside_accident_coverage in the 20 km buffer

origin_quality.description: Network origin quality from TICKET-00 (D-004): good <= 50 m, fair <= 100 m, poor > 100 m (scored, flagged), none = no main-network edge within 500 m (not computable).

score_null_reason.description: Why the building has no score (origin_quality = none). NULL when scores exist. A NULL walk_min_<category> on a scored building means 'no POI within 15 minutes', not 'not computable'.
score_null_reason.null_semantics: NULL when scores exist; the reason code when the building has no origin (origin_quality = none)

comfort_mean_400m.description: Modelled, not measured. Mean pedestrian comfort (walk_segments comfort_score, 0-100) of the street network within 400 m of walking distance from the building origin (connector included), weighted by the length of each segment inside the radius; unscored segments are left out (TICKET-02, D-011). NULL = see score_null_reason (no origin) or comfort_null_reason_400m.
comfort_mean_400m.null_semantics: NULL when the building has no main-network origin (origin_quality = none; reason in score_null_reason), or when the *_null_reason_400m column gives the reason (connector longer than 400 m, or nothing scored within the radius)

comfort_scored_share_400m.description: Share of the network length within 400 m that carries a comfort_score (the rest is unscored).
comfort_scored_share_400m.null_semantics: NULL when the building has no main-network origin (origin_quality = none; reason in score_null_reason), or when the *_null_reason_400m column gives the reason (connector longer than 400 m, or nothing scored within the radius)

comfort_null_reason_400m.description: Why comfort_mean_400m is NULL on a building with an origin: connector_exceeds_radius = the building-to-network connector is longer than 400 m; no_scored_segments = nothing scored within the radius. NULL when computed or when there is no origin.
comfort_null_reason_400m.null_semantics: NULL when comfort_mean_400m was computed or when the building has no origin; otherwise the reason code

safety_index_400m.description: Modelled, not measured. Length-weighted safety_index of walking-network segments reachable within 400 m from the existing building origin (connector included). Higher = lower modelled recorded-crash concentration. NULL for no origin (see score_null_reason) or safety_null_reason_400m.
safety_index_400m.null_semantics: NULL when the building has no main-network origin (origin_quality = none; reason in score_null_reason), or when the *_null_reason_400m column gives the reason (connector longer than 400 m, or nothing scored within the radius)

safety_covered_len_400m_m.description: Length of safety-scored walking network used for safety_index_400m.
safety_covered_len_400m_m.null_semantics: NULL when the building has no main-network origin (origin_quality = none; reason in score_null_reason), or when the *_null_reason_400m column gives the reason (connector longer than 400 m, or nothing scored within the radius)

safety_null_reason_400m.description: Why safety_index_400m is NULL on a building with an origin: connector_exceeds_radius or no_covered_segments. NULL when calculated or when there is no origin.
safety_null_reason_400m.null_semantics: NULL when safety_index_400m was calculated or when the building has no origin; otherwise the reason code
